paragraphs: (Doeg the Edomite, Psalms 52:2.) Yoma 38b, also cited in Torat Kohanim, Bechukotai, and Eichah Rabbah 1:51, relates that Doeg ben Yosef’s father left him a small child to his mother. Every day his mother measured him in handbreadths and gave his weight in gold to the Temple. When the enemy prevailed, his mother slaughtered and ate him.
